title: MINCE: Shrinking LLM Evaluation Datasets via Few-Model Monte Carlo Calibration
abstract: arXiv:2606.22826v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Evaluating LLMs across many model variants---quantized, fine-tuned, or deployment-specific---requires running large benchmarks repeatedly, a process that can take tens of hours per model on edge hardware such as NPUs. Existing subset selection methods reduce this cost but depend on large calibration pools or learned prediction layers. We introduce MINCE (Monte Carlo Informed N-sizing for Compact Evaluation), which uses Monte Carlo simulation over per-item logs from a small set of calibration models to find the minimum subset size that bounds accuracy drift and then fixes a randomly sampled subset at that size, with no prediction layer needed. MINCE reduces IFEVAL by 54\%, MMLU by 89\%, GSM8K by 70\%, and MMLU-Pro by 88\% with maximum drift $\leq$2.62\,pp on BF16 calibration models. translated_title: MINCE：通过少模型蒙特卡洛校准缩减大语言模型评估数据集
translated_abstract: 在多种大语言模型变体（量化版、微调版或部署专用版）上进行评估，需要反复运行大型基准测试，在NPU等边缘硬件上每个模型可能耗时数十小时。现有的子集选择方法虽能降低这一成本，但依赖于大规模校准模型池或需要学习的预测层。我们提出MINCE（Monte Carlo Informed siNing for Compact Evaluation），该方法利用少量校准模型的逐条目日志进行蒙特卡洛模拟，找到能够约束精度漂移的最小子集规模，然后在该规模下固定一个随机采样的子集，无需任何预测层。在BF16校准模型上，MINCE将IFEVAL缩减54%、MMLU缩减89%、GSM8K缩减70%、MMLU-Pro缩减88%，最大漂移≤2.62个百分点。所固定的子集可泛化到留出的GPU模型（平均漂移≤1.40个百分点）以及INT4 NPU模型（平均漂移为0.77–3.59个百分点）。
tldr: MINCE利用少量校准模型进行蒙特卡洛模拟，自动确定能约束精度漂移的最小评估子集规模，无需预测层即可将主流LLM基准数据集缩减54%–89%，并能良好泛化到未见过的GPU和NPU模型。
en_tdlr: MINCE uses Monte Carlo simulation over logs from a few calibration models to determine the minimum evaluation subset size that bounds accuracy drift, shrinking major LLM benchmarks by 54%–89% without any prediction layer while generalizing well to unseen GPU and NPU models.
